differences.a_observable: Top and bottom areas of the frame are heavily defocused.
differences.b_observable: The entire frame is in sharp focus with no depth of field blur.
differences.fix: Enable depth of field on the camera to match the reference's focus falloff.

differences.a_observable: High contrast with deep shadows in the crevices between tiles.
differences.b_observable: Flat, washed-out lighting with very bright, greyish shadows.
differences.fix: Adjust light setup and shadow settings to deepen shadows and increase contrast.

differences.a_observable: Warm, golden color cast over the white tiles.
differences.b_observable: Neutral to cool, greyish color cast on the white tiles.
differences.fix: Warm up the lighting or add a warm color grade.

json.highest_impact_fix: Implement a strong depth of field effect on the camera to match the professional focus falloff of the reference.
